proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2871 karpaṭa explicitly gives Kashmiri kapur cotton cloth, Sindhi kapaṛu and widespread kapaṛ/kapṛa cloth forms. Selected kapur/kepeḍa/kapəṛu responses preserve this family, with vowel variation and dental/retroflex-r notation qualified. Turner discusses competing deeper origins and explicit IA borrowing; the link does not settle those issues or local transmission. Exact response: kepeḍa.
